vp.rationale: Reject INV-1008 from NoProd Industries (2026-01-10), total $9,900.00 USD. Error findings: SuperGizmo (12 × $400.00 = $4,800.00) and MegaSprocket (6 × $850.00 = $5,100.00) are not in inventory; catalog lookup returned found=false for both. Invoice history has no prior runs, so no number conflict. Currency is USD and total is under $10,000.00. The noproduct.biz sender warning is uncorroborated and does not change the required rejection.
checklist_responses: Error — Line 1 SuperGizmo not in inventory (lookup found=false); 12 × $400.00 = $4,800.00. Reject.
Error — Line 2 MegaSprocket not in inventory (lookup found=false); 6 × $850.00 = $5,100.00. Reject.
Currency USD — no non-USD review trigger.
Price above catalog — neither line is in catalog, so no catalog price to compare; errors already require reject.
Revised invoice — document does not state a revision.
Invoice-number conflict — get_invoice_history for INV-1008 returned no prior runs.
Risk signal — billing@noproduct.biz domain mismatch is a warning only; history does not show another vendor or a payment redirect, so it does not alter the error-based reject.

critic.summary: The reject decision matches policy and the case file; inventory misses, amounts, history, and the uncorroborated sender warning are all correctly handled.
